pr_body:
Closes #80

## Summary

Documents how to run and interpret the generated issue dashboard alongside the curated roadmap.

## Changes

- Adds `docs/issue_dashboard_runbook.md` with GitHub CLI prerequisites, generator commands, state filters, output policy, and interpretation notes.
- Links the dashboard runbook from `docs/roadmap.md`.
- Updates `docs/roadmap.md` to reflect the merged dashboard design and generator work and to distinguish curated roadmap content from generated snapshots.

## Validation

- `git apply --check /mnt/data/issue80v2.diff` on the exact v2 unified diff in a clean temporary git worktree.
- Documentation-only review of links, commands, and repository paths.

## Note

The first submission failed at broker `git apply --check`; v2 removes the problematic no-newline patch markers and narrows the scope to the new runbook plus roadmap links.
